edge_cases: 4x4 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 4 K-tiles (K=128)

HMX + uDMA COMPOSE in a partitioned VTCM: two double-buffered crouton operand slots (act 2KB x2 @0x0000/0x0800, wgt 1KB x2 @0x1000/0x1400) + requant-config @0x2000 + output crouton @0x3000 -- disjoint regions, no fault
DMA double-buffer: pack K-tile kt+1's crouton in cacheable DDR, uDMA it into the ALTERNATE VTCM slot (async) while HMX computes K-tile kt from the current slot
HMX accumulator persists across K-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per output tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead); weight 4-deep packed; different load limits in one packet
HMX 0x40-config requant gives r=(acc*17+8)>>4, sign-extended from the 12-bit field; input ranges keep |r|<2048 so the field is exact (no HMX saturation)
fused HVX/scalar epilogue: per-column int32 bias -> ReLU -> saturating narrow to uint8
bias includes extreme (-2000/+2000) and zero edge values so ReLU-zero, uint8-saturate-high, and passthrough all occur
harness installs identity VTCM add_translation AND enables the HMX context so DMA and HMX coexist
harness reference computed via independent HVX vrmpy, cross-checked against a scalar golden on row 0
M,N,K are 32-multiples (crouton requirement), so the classic 128-tail rule does not apply; discrimination via nearmiss + edge bias values
name: i8_gemm_tiled_bias_relu_requant
